incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=runtime-inference: alert=inference.p95_above_threshold count=3 region=us-west2
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty INC-1758000000 created and paging rotation 'eng-oncall' -> @sam
sam: acked the page via PagerDuty, I'm looking
sam: first glance: p95 jumped to ~520ms for a few minutes, error rates normal
sam: checking pods
sam: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l role=runtime` -> 12/12 ready, no OOMs
sam: grabbing recent logs: `kubectl logs -n inference -l role=runtime --since=5m` ... seeing repeated 'KV cache miss - coldstart' entries
alex: saw similar pattern earlier; often KV warmups from traffic bursts, usually auto-resolves
sam: is there any spike in traffic? metrics show a short staircase of requests from a test harness (5 cold bots)
priya: looks like a canary job in us-west2 ran a sweep at 12:03, executing long prompts (seq=2048) — that can cause transient p95 spikes
ops_lead: impact? any customer-facing timeouts or errors?
sam: no 5xx spikes, only higher tail latency for a limited window, traffic returned to normal
incident-bot: Escalation timer 2m -> still open; auto-resolve configured at 5m if metric returns
sam: I'm going to silence the PagerDuty alert for 10m for the alert fingerprint (metric+region) to avoid flap :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: `/pd silence INC-1758000000 for 10m --reason "kv-warmup-induced p95 blip; investigated; no customer impact"`
incident-bot: PagerDuty silence applied by sam
pagerduty-bot: INC-1758000000 acknowledged and silence in effect
alex: can we add a short-term suppression rule or increase evaluation window? This looks like a repeat pattern when the canary runs
priya: suggested config: evaluate p95 over 3m->5m window, and require >2 evaluation periods
sam: filed a quick ops ticket: `GH-ops/alert-tuning#142` with logs and timeframe
sam: monitoring: p95 back to 80ms
sam: resolving thread, but handing next shift to alex for follow-up (I'm off in 40m)
alex: taking followup, will check canary schedule and consider staggering or rate-limiting it
ops_lead: good catch. No customer impact; mark as resolved in PD once auto-resolve completes
pagerduty-bot: INC-1758000000 auto-resolved (duration 6m) :white_check_mark:
sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
priya: can we add a post-mortem note: 'short-lived KV warmup from scheduled canary — consider jittering schedule' — I'll add to the ops ticket
alex: also adding a transient suppression rule and a short alert playbook (how to check kv warmup quickly)
incident-bot: Thread closed (auto-resolve).
